definitions.explanation: cunning; crafty; sneaky; stingy in a calculating way

examples.japanese: こすい{手|て}を{使|つか}うな。
{彼|かれ}はこすいところがある。
examples.english: He has a sly side to him.

examples.japanese: そんなこすいやり{方|かた}で{勝|か}っても{嬉|うれ}しくない。
examples.english: It wouldn't be satisfying to win using such underhanded methods.

notes:
こすい is an informal i-adjective describing someone or something that is cunning or sneakily stingy.

USAGE:
- Implies cleverness used for selfish gain
- Can include being stingy or penny-pinching in a calculating way
- Has a negative, critical connotation

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- こすい{手|て} (sneaky trick/method)
- こすいやり{方|かた} (underhanded approach)
- こすい{人|ひと} (sly/crafty person)
- こすい{真似|まね} (sneaky behavior)

REGIONAL NOTES:
- More commonly used in western Japan, particularly Kansai region
- Standard Japanese equivalent: ずるい (sly, unfair)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ずるい: Sly, unfair (standard Japanese, more common)
- {狡猾|こうかつ}: Cunning, crafty (more formal/literary)
- せこい: Petty, small-minded (similar colloquial feel)
- こすい: Sly in a calculating, stingy way (regional/colloquial)

REGISTER: Informal. Colloquial and critical.
